question: The length of each of the two equal sides of an isosceles triangle is 41 cm and the length of its base is 18 cm. The area (in cm²) of the triangle is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Height of **isosceles triangle** (h) = √(a² − (b/2)²) where a = 41 and b = 18.

h = √(41² − 9²) = √(1681 − 81) = √1600 = 40 cm.

Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 18 × 40 = 360 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 360 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: **Equal sides (a)** = 41 cm, **Base (b)** = 18 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c23a499778cd9df463afd0170be11ad6e225c1d72270885c1fe8001e66698458.png] 

Using **Pythagoras Theorem** in the right-angled half-triangle:

⇒ Height² + (Base/2)² = (Equal side)²

⇒ h² + 9² = 41²

⇒ h² + 81 = 1681

⇒ h² = 1600

⇒ h = 40 cm

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 18 × 40

⇒ Area = 360 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 360 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)), where s is the semi-perimeter (a+b+c)/2.

Isosceles Triangle Area Formula

Area = (b/4) × √(4a² − b²), where a is the equal side and b is the base.

Perimeter of Isosceles Triangle

Perimeter = 2a + b, representing the sum of all three boundaries.</p
